labels.notes: There is no paper label. The check is that each statement equals HEAD's. The REPORT's ranges were compared with `diff` against `git show HEAD:` copies. HEAD LemmaKBare.lean:579-669 is identical to Model/LemmaKModels.lean:66-156, and HEAD LemmaKSCLocal.lean:117-119 to LemmaKModels.lean:160-162. The new module's prelude has the same context as its sources: `namespace Causal`, the same `open`, `universe u`, `variable {M : Type u} [TopologicalSpace M]`, and the static section's own `variable {X : Type*} [MetricSpace X] [GeodesicSpace X]` inside `namespace staticCausality`. The eight constants have identical #check output (pp.universes, pp.fullNames) and identical type and value hashes (see independent_checks). Only their module changed: LemmaKBare, resp. LemmaKSCLocal -> Causal.Model.LemmaKModels. Each uses exactly [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]. The module is under Causal/Model/ (is_model true) and marks no label. Its docstring follows kb/0006: title, 'No label is marked', a quote, checklist, SCOPE, Provenance. The quote is papers/barbot/legacy/labeled/GHFspace.tex:576-578, verbatim, and the label is at :572 as stated. Every name in the hypothesis checklist exists where it says: staticCausality.tarentin, .globallyHyperbolic, .causallyArcConnected, .pushUp, .mem_Zplus and .mem_Zminus in Causal.Static, and .curvesExtend in Causal.Model.CurvesExtendModels. 'So is Minkowski space' is literal, since `minkowski n` is an abbrev for `staticCausality (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))` (Minkowski.lean:76). The reading the closer took is sound. The timelike-line witnesses stay in LemmaKBare and LemmaKSCLocal, and both modules' compiled closures contain no model module.
